subject: Linguistics
title: Logographic Systems
description: A quick, practical guide to Logographic Systems.

hook.text: Each Chinese character represents a word or morpheme—there's no alphabet to sound things out.

buildup.text: Logographic systems use symbols that represent meanings, not individual sounds.

discovery.text: Chinese has about 50,000 characters; literacy requires knowing around 3,000 to 4,000.

twist.text: Most Chinese characters actually contain a phonetic hint—they're not purely meaning-based.

climax.text: Logographic systems are harder to learn but allow readers of different dialects to share one written standard.

punchline.text: One symbol, one meaning—across dialects and centuries.

quiz.question: What does a logographic symbol represent?
